units.source_text: 小侍从不知道那天窥帘之事，以为只是寻常求爱的情书。

en.t: Ko Jijuu did not know about the incident that day when he had glimpsed through the curtain, and thought it was only an ordinary love letter.

units.source_text: 便趁三公主身边侍女稀少之时，将此信呈阅，说道：

en.t: So she waited until there were few serving women near the Third Princess, presented the letter for her to read, and said:

units.source_text: “这个人一直不能忘怀，到现在还写信来，真讨厌啊！

en.t: This man still cannot forget, and even now he keeps sending letters. How troublesome!

units.source_text: 但我看到他那刻骨相思之苦，又似觉不忍坐视。

en.t: But when I see how deeply he suffers from love, I feel as though I cannot simply look on and do nothing.

units.source_text: 如何是好，连我自己也弄不清楚了。”

en.t: What should be done? Even I myself no longer know.

units.source_text: 说着笑起来。

en.t: As she said this, she began to laugh.

units.source_text: 三公主无心无思地说道：“你又来讲讨厌的话了。”

en.t: The Third Princess said absentmindedly, "You are saying unpleasant things again."

units.source_text: 便看看那封展开着的信。

en.t: Then she looked at the letter lying open before her.

units.source_text: 看到引用古歌的地方，记得上句是“依稀看不真”，

en.t: When she came to the passage quoting an old poem, she remembered that the first line was "dimly seen, not clearly,"

units.source_text: 就想起了那天小猫揭起帘子的意外之事，脸上便泛红了。

en.t: and she recalled the unexpected incident that day when the kitten lifted the curtain, and her face flushed red.

units.source_text: 她记得源氏每逢适当机会便训诫她说：

en.t: She remembered that Genji had admonished her whenever the opportunity arose, saying:

units.source_text: “你切不可给夕雾大将看见！

en.t: You must never let General Yugiri see you!

units.source_text: 你年纪还小，难免粗心大意，被他窥见。”

en.t: You are still young, and you may be careless and let him catch a glimpse of you.

units.source_text: 因此她想：“如果那天窥见我的是夕雾大将，

en.t: So she thought, "If the one who glimpsed me that day had been General Yugiri,

units.source_text: 而被源氏主君知道了，我将如何遭受谴责！”

en.t: and Lord Genji had learned of it, how severely I would have been reproached!"

units.source_text: 而被柏木窥见，她倒满不在乎。

en.t: Yet she was quite unconcerned that Kashiwagi had seen her.

units.source_text: 她心中只知道惧怕源氏，真乃幼稚之见！

en.t: In her heart she knew only to fear Genji. What a childish way of thinking!

units.source_text: 小侍从看见她今天特别郁闷，无心答复，觉得扫兴，

en.t: Ko Jijuu saw that she was especially dejected today and had no wish to answer, and felt disappointed,

units.source_text: 未便强要她写回信，便偷偷地代她写了一封。

en.t: so she did not force her to write a reply, but secretly wrote one on her behalf.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“前日闯入园中，实乃荒唐之举，罪不可恕。

en.t: The letter said: "Your intrusion into the garden the other day was truly an outrageous act, and the offense cannot be forgiven.

units.source_text: 来信引用‘一面匆匆见’之诗，不知所指何事？

en.t: In your letter you quoted a poem about 'one hurried glimpse'; I do not know what you meant by it.

units.source_text: 岂别有用意乎？”

en.t: Could there perhaps be some other intention behind it?"

units.source_text: 笔致非常流畅，又答诗云：

en.t: The handwriting was extremely fluent, and she also wrote this poem in reply:
